commentary.text: 90+6' Juan Martinez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' The substitution has been made. Walid Cheddira (Espanyol) has replaced Alex Kral.
90+1' Juan Soriano (Leganes) is given a red card for some unsportsmanlike conduct off the pitch.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
90' Leganes have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
89' Diego Garcia (Leganes) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
89' A quickly taken corner by Espanyol.
88' Exposito (Espanyol) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. Espanyol force a corner. They send men into the box.
85' Borja Jimenez prepares a substitution. Miguel de la Fuente is replaced by Diego Garcia (Leganes).
85' Borja Jimenez is forced to make a change. Yvan Neyou (Leganes) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Roberto Lopez.
84' Handball by Alejo Veliz (Espanyol).
81' The game is interrupted as Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) is flagged offside.
80' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fernando Calero (Espanyol) replacing Pol Lozano.
79' Substitution. Jofre leaves the pitch and is replaced by Irvin Cardona (Espanyol).
74' Leganes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

74' Joan Garcia pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Juan Cruz (Leganes) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the bottom right corner. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Leganes.
74' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Joan Garcia stops the ball from going inside right post.
73' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) blows a good opportunity to score. Without hesitation he fires in a shot from mid range, but the ball crashes against the left post!
73' The attendance is 26606.
71' Darko Brasanac (Leganes) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
69' The resulting set piece from Espanyol is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
68' Dani Raba (Leganes) is substituted due to injury. Borja Jimenez gives a chance to Javi Hernandez.

68' Jofre (Espanyol) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Espanyol.
65' Dani Raba (Leganes) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
64' A dangerous looking corner kick from Exposito (Espanyol) is cleared to safety by the defence.
64' The resulting corner from Exposito (Espanyol) is cleared by the opposition's defence. Espanyol have a corner.
62' Here is a change. Alvaro Tejero is going off and Manolo Gonzalez gives the last tactical orders to Alejo Veliz (Espanyol).
62' Substitution. Antoniu Roca walks off the pitch and Exposito (Espanyol) comes on as a substitute.

59' What a wasted opportunity by Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the left side of the goal, but Joan Garcia makes an astonishing save to thwart him.

57' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the middle of the goal, but Joan Garcia is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
52' The game is interrupted now, Renato Tapia (Leganes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Espanyol comes to nothing.
50' Ooh that was close! Javi Puado (Espanyol) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
50' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) commits a rough challenge and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' Juan Martinez shows the yellow card to Dani Raba (Leganes) for a heavy challenge.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
41' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) is penalised for holding. Juan Martinez signals a set piece. Leganes will take a free kick near the side line.
40' Juan Cruz (Leganes) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
37' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) is adjudged offside.
36' A pass from Brian Olivan (Espanyol) is intercepted by Marko Dmitrovic and the move breaks down.
33' Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

31' Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) connects with an inch-perfect cross and from around the penalty spot he steers a header towards the left side of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic pulls off a brilliant save and diverts the ball onto the post.
31' Espanyol work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
28' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
24' Jofre (Espanyol) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post!

21' That didn't go as planned! Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Marko Dmitrovic, who easily kept it out.
17' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
17' Espanyol will take a corner kick.
17' Jofre (Espanyol) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
15' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) was probably a bit loose with his words to Juan Martinez, who decides to show him a yellow.
14' Alex Kral (Espanyol) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Juan Martinez lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
14' 1 - 1 Goal! Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
12' Brian Olivan (Espanyol) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
11' Foul! Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
11' Leganes earn a corner.

10' Jofre (Espanyol) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Marko Dmitrovic!
7' Juan Cruz (Leganes) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
6' Matija Nastasic (Leganes) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post.
6' It will be a corner kick for Leganes.
6' Darko Brasanac (Leganes) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
4' The linesman signals that Javi Puado (Espanyol) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
2' 1 - 0 Goal! Alex Kral gets up really well from the corner and heads the ball into the six-yard box where Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) glances a header into the net. 1:0.
2' Espanyol win a corner.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Leganes will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Juan Martinez.
